description.value: Bruce's Country Market is a family-owned institution in Maple Ridge operating since 1948, founded by the McEachern family as a local fish market supplying fresh West Coast seafood from their own fishing fleet. Today it has grown into a full-service market featuring an extensive fresh and smoked wild salmon counter, deli and restaurant with house-made soups and hot meals, and a produce section sourcing from local lower mainland farms. The market ships its branded products across North America and remains one of the original 'ocean to you' seafood destinations in the Fraser Valley.
